note: Held-out synthetic set written after the v1.0 findings and before measuring the fixes on it. Different author, corpus and questions. Author display name: Dad (shared harness).

items.title: Grandma's vegetable garden
items.body: Every spring we planted tomatoes, spinach and beans behind the house. Grandma said a garden teaches you to wait.

items.title: Patience
items.body: Most good things take longer than you want. Plant today and be patient.

items.title: Borrowing money
items.body: Never borrow money to buy things that lose value. Borrow only for a home or an education.

items.title: Nursing at Baragwanath hospital
items.body: I worked night shifts as a nurse for twenty years. Caring for strangers made me braver than I thought I could be.

items.title: Forgiveness
items.body: Forgive people for your own peace, not because they deserve it. You do not have to forget.

items.title: Our wedding day
items.body: It rained on our wedding day in 1989 and the tent flooded. We danced in the mud and laughed until midnight.

items.title: Reading at the library
items.body: As a girl I walked to the library every Saturday. Books took me to places I could not afford to go.

items.title: Raising children
items.body: Children need more of your time than your money. Sit with them, listen, and be there at bedtime.

items.title: When I was sick in 2015
items.body: When I had cancer treatment in 2015, the neighbours cooked for us for three months. Accept help when it is offered.

items.title: Notes about the will
items.body: DRAFT: the house should go to whoever needs it most, still deciding.

items.title: Voice note about Christmas
items.body: Christmas was always at our house.
items.machine_transcript: Machine heard: sell the house and buy shares
